scripts.build: rm -f prisma.config.ts prisma.config.js && rm -rf node_modules .prisma prisma/.prisma .next && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && node db-setup.js && PRISMA_CLI_QUERY_ENGINE_TYPE=binary npx prisma --version && PRISMA_CLI_QUERY_ENGINE_TYPE=binary npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && next build
scripts.postinstall: if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then npm run build; fi
scripts.prestart: rm -f src/middleware.ts src/proxy.ts && [ -d .next ] || npm run build
scripts.start: sh -c 'PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=binary NODE_ENV=production node runtime-init.js && PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=binary NODE_ENV=production node index.js'
